reason: Frozen V8.3 requires every mutation to have main support and at least one internal pair to have pair support. Only 131/4178 official IRED test identities satisfy this identity-only structural rule.
diagnostic_population: the exact identity-only frozen-V8.3 scoreable test subset
ndcg_definition: sklearn.metrics.ndcg_score; if any diagnostic y_true is negative, shift all y_true by subtracting min(y_true); predictions are unshifted ranking scores
validation_rule: validation == True excluded from fit and never used for tuning
result_interpretation: Diagnostic subset metrics do not convert MODEL_SCOPE_FAIL into a Phase-2D PASS and are not directly comparable to published full-test FLIP2 baselines.
